datasets.title: scRNA-seq pbmc3k: 400 cells x 500 genes
datasets.units: d = sqrt(2(1 - Spearman rho)) between cells, dimensionless
datasets.notes: 10x Genomics PBMC 3k (the dataset scanpy.datasets.pbmc3k downloads). genes: 500 most variable genes detected in >= 5% of cells (no cell-cycle list used). QC {"log10_lib_min": 2.86566759436781, "detected_min": 204.08540000000005}; 2625 cells pass QC, 400 used (subsample seed 20260920). BREADTH dataset: discrete immune cell types, no cell-cycle loop is expected and none is claimed.

params.metric: sqrt(2(1-spearman rho)) between cells, fed directly to Rips (NO PCA, NO MDS)

runs.preprocessing: CPM log2(x+1); cell-cycle genes (tinyatlas list) detected in >= 5% of cells; z-scored per gene

controls.description: gene-wise permutation destroys cell-cell covariance and keeps every gene's marginal
controls.detail: NOT RUN TO COMPLETION: the gene-permutation null did not complete: 81 of 200 draws at roughly 13 s each on a 400-cell correlation metric. No p-value is stored, because a p-value without its null is not storable.

controls.description: the same number of random expressed genes outside the selected set
published cell-cycle loop should appear as a dominant H1
controls.detail: dominance 1.510; NOT RUN TO COMPLETION: the gene-permutation null did not complete: 81 of 200 draws at roughly 13 s each on a 400-cell correlation metric. No p-value is stored, because a p-value without its null is not storable.

findings.claim: u2os: Rips on the cell-cell Spearman metric over 97 genes gives H1 dominance 1.51 and S 0.0221. NO p-value: the gene-permutation null did not complete: 81 of 200 draws at roughly 13 s each on a 400-cell correlation metric. No p-value is stored, because a p-value without its null is not storable. Pre-stated criteria (dominance >= 2 and p <= 0.01): NOT MET.
findings.caveat: This is a different pipeline from the earlier genetics validation (Rips on the correlation metric in full dimension, not alpha on a 3-D PCA), pre-stated before running. Nothing was tuned after seeing the result.
